text:
54세 남자 환자, acute hemorrhagic stroke로 입원함.  
BP 180/100 mmHg, HR 88 bpm, RR 22 breaths/min, BT 36.8°C, SpO2 95% on room air.  
Severe headache 호소함.  
Labetalol 20 mg IV STAT 투여함.  
CT scan of the head 시행함.  
C-line 적용함.  
24시간 동안 500 mL positive fluid balance 확인됨.  
환자 stuporous 상태임.  
Neurology team notify함.
